body: The two items are bundled beside clouded sample jar; field dust lies beneath them, while a strip of road tape is caught around the bundle.
title: Clouded sample jar by the counter
gloss: Field residue and response material share one personal bundle.
rival_reading: Field work and a hurried emergency response could each explain the mixed residue and road tape; neither fixes which came first.

body: The map is folded to hide three streets, and the water bottle has a fresh mark for each one. Whoever drove here was counting stops before anyone on the road knew there was a route.
title: A sealed morning route
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
